messages.author: 3fc22ca52a17d8b1
messages.subject: building cran package "lme4" for renjin.
parts:
I need to use the R package "lme4" for mixed models but as it appears that the package is not yet built for renjin. Can someone guide me how to build CRAN packages for renjin?
Help is much appreciated.

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: building cran package "lme4" for renjin.
parts:
Hi, the latest version of lme4, is not yet built, but you can see the results of an earlier version here:
http://packages.renjin.org/package/org.renjin.cran/lme4/1.1-8

Unfortunately, it looks like this package requires the Matrix package, which currently does not build under Renjin because of some problems with Renjin's implementation of S4. 

S4 support in Renjin is something we will be working alot on in the coming months so stay tuned for now!

Alex
